headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.29
summary: The Logcat overlay now captures the game's full engine log: Minecraft writes its detailed console output to stdout/stderr, which used to vanish into /dev/null, and those lines are now redirected into the log capture so the overlay and adb logcat both show the complete stream.

items.text: Capture the game's stdout/stderr log stream alongside the existing logcat hook — enable the Logcat overlay with App-Level Logging and every engine line (tagged MCPE) lands in the overlay, even on devices where logd drops app logs.
